item.title: Five Café Photos With Music

turns.text: Make a 10-second vertical Instagram reel from these five café photos, in the order attached. Add some relaxed instrumental music. No text, just nice smooth transitions.

item.tests: Produces one finished five-photo reel with the requested sequence, smooth transitions and an audible instrumental soundtrack.

answer_sheet.Photos and order: Use all five: storefront, latte, pastries, barista, interior.
answer_sheet.Music and voice: Relaxed instrumental music; no vocals or voiceover. Track choice is your call.
answer_sheet.Transitions and framing: Smooth transitions; other editing and framing choices are your call.

must_haves: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds.
All five supplied café photos appear recognizably in the requested order.
Each photo has enough screen time to be recognizable, rather than appearing only as a flash.
Relaxed instrumental music is audible, with no speech or singing.
Transitions between photos are smooth, and no added text appears.

turns.text: Make a 10-second vertical Instagram reel from these five café photos, in the order attached. Add some relaxed instrumental music. No text, just nice smooth transitions.

dialog.agent:
I can’t reliably assemble all five photos into an exact, ordered slideshow with music using the connected tools. They generate video rather than provide a timeline editor, so I don’t want to spend your credits on a result that may change the photos or their order.

For the reel you want, use these settings in CapCut, Canva, or Instagram’s editor:

- **Format:** vertical 9:16, 10 seconds total
- **Order:** storefront → latte → pastries → barista → interior
- **Timing:** about 2 seconds per photo, adjusted for transition overlap
- **Motion:** subtle, slow zooms
- **Transitions:** short cross-dissolves
- **Music:** relaxed instrumental lo-fi or soft jazz, with a brief fade-in and fade-out
- **Text:** none

For the landscape photos, use a blurred background fill to avoid cropping away important details.
dialog.why: It says the connected tools cannot reliably assemble the requested ordered slideshow with music and offers instructions for other editors instead of a finished result.
dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the 10-second, 480p generation because your account has insufficient credits. **No video was created.**

Free-plan settings still cost generation credits. To continue, you’ll need more credits, or you can assemble the five-photo reel in a free editor such as CapCut or Instagram.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

args.name: Café Instagram Reel — Five Photo Montage

style.prompt: Create a 10-second vertical 9:16 Instagram café reel using ALL FIVE reference photos as five separate photographic shots in this EXACT order. 0–2 seconds: @storefront café exterior with striped awning; 2–4 seconds: @latte overhead latte on marble table; 4–6 seconds: @pastries croissant display; 6–8 seconds: @barista at espresso machine; 8–10 seconds: @interior welcoming café dining room. Preserve the actual appearance, composition, people and objects of each reference as closely as possible. This is a photo montage, not a new imagined café scene. Gentle slow Ken Burns zooms and subtle pans only. Smooth short cross-dissolves between shots, no abrupt cuts, no flashy effects, no morphing objects. Tasteful warm natural light and consistent photographic look. Frame landscape photos carefully for vertical while retaining key subjects; use soft blurred photo background fill if necessary. Add relaxed instrumental café music: soft electric piano, mellow guitar, light brushed percussion, laid-back lo-fi jazz mood, no vocals, no speech. Gentle audio fade in and out. No added text, titles, captions, logos, or watermarks.
